notes.title: Fragment Hunters is now free to play!
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

You read that correctly, Fragment Hunters is not only back from retirement and available again, but it is now also completely free to play! So hop in your starships and have some fun!


I'll repeat the current status of the project here once more for those who missed the previous announcements:
[i]
Fragment Hunters is likely not going to receive further updates. 
When I started this project, it was far above my skill level, and because I was so far out of my depth, the game ended up fighting its own identity, becoming a rather mediocre product throughout.
Fixing the current design-issues with Fragment Hunters would require an investment on my part that I'm simply unable to make, in part due to it having been built on the unity game engine. 

Simply put: I have to move forward! That's a good thing, because it means there are loads of exciting projects on the horizon. It's going to be a blast and I hope to see all of you there![/i]

To keep this major part of my life and past learning process alive, I decided to re-release Fragment Hunters as a free to play app.

[b]If you have already bought the game.[/b]
You're kept in a special little list and I'm planning to reward all those who supported my first released project in upcoming future projects. You guys are a huge motivation to me. Thank you, all of you.


I don't currently have a mailing list set up so if you want to stay up to date, have any questions about Fragment Hunters, or simply wish to reach out, hop on into the discord server!
https://discord.gg/MhUuSvVZE4
